title: Shingardar Stupa
subtitle: Buddhist stupa beside the N-95 between Ghalegay and Barikot, Lower Swat

landmark.name: Shingardar Stupa
edits: The stupa is the Tiny Atlas procedural maquette: 18 m high (published height, livius.org); the drum bands, the grass cap and the diameter of about 21 m are estimated from the photos.
The levelled ground of 22 m radius around the stupa is estimated from the photos; the surrounding slope and village are the DEM and OSM data.
